line: A reconstruction: an invented fellowship's teaching tape whose every lesson is quoted or closely paraphrased from a ministry handbook, two Exodus booklets and a class manual, 1993–1996, held in the Smithsonian's Love in Action Collection.

facts.text: December 1973: the American Psychiatric Association's Board of Trustees voted to remove homosexuality from the DSM (upheld by a 58% majority of voting members).
facts.source: Behavioral Sciences 5(4):565–575 (2015), 'Out of DSM: Depathologizing Homosexuality', read 15 Nov 2026

facts.text: 1987: 'ego-dystonic homosexuality' was removed from the next revision, DSM-III-R.
facts.source: Behavioral Sciences 5(4) (2015), 'Out of DSM', read 15 Nov 2026

facts.text: May 1990: the World Health Assembly adopted ICD-10 (WHA43.24; into effect 1 January 1993). ICD-10, block F66, Note: 'Sexual orientation by itself is not to be regarded as a disorder.'
facts.source: WHO, ICD revisions table (adoption and effect dates) and the ICD-10 browser (2019 version), F66 Note, both read 15 Nov 2026

invented: TriedPath Fellowship, its Pocket Library, the 'Mountains of Material' cassette set, the phone numbers (fictional 555-01xx), Lamby's bubbles and the felt board are the piece's. No real person is shown or named.
music: Music: made in code for this tape by Claude (Anthropic, Opus 5.5)
